title: [3.1.0.3] After short term profile change, automatic revert to previous longer profile instead of resetting to 100%
body:
Tried multiple times, last at 10:26.
I had previously set a temp profile (90%) for many hours. In a previous release (2.8.2.1) I could set up a 10 minute temp profile of 100% while the 90% was active in order to override it and reset the profile to 100% going forward even after the 10 minutes have passed  .

Now, with v. 3.1.0.3, after the 10 minutes of 100% profile change, the profile changes back to 90% for the reminder of the initial time.

This makes things very cumbersome as one needs to always take into account the length of the previous profile change when making current changes...

because of this design behavior cannot be changed.
